-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.InvStop` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def backend.bStopView (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (D :
    backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(W ∗
      Pk ∗
        backend.viewAt γ (backend.sData P D) ∗
          backend.pvHalf γ (backend.sData P D) ∗
            backend.hkOwn γ (backend.hkData P D) ∗
              backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P D) ∗ backend.ckHalf γ (backend.fkVals D))

def backend.isStopChansE (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ W Pk, backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗ backend.isStopChans γ P W Pk b)

theorem backend.stopQ_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) : Persistent (backend.stopQ γ)

theorem backend.isStopChans_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF)
    (b : Loc) : Persistent (backend.isStopChans γ P W Pk b)

theorem backend.isStopChansE_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) :
    Persistent (backend.isStopChansE γ P b)

theorem backend.bDoneEsc_take (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (sc :
    GoChan) (γsc : ChanNames) : ⊢ backend.bDoneEsc γ P W Pk -∗ backend.stopInv γ sc γsc -∗
    backend.stopQ γ -∗ ghostVar γ.cls (Qp.half 1) () -∗ £ 1 -∗ £ 1 ={⊤}=∗ backend.bDBOut γ P W Pk

theorem backend.runTok_timeless (γ : backend.BNames) : Timeless (backend.runTok γ)

def backend.bDoneEsc (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  inv (backend.bN.@"dbesc") iprop(backend.bDBOut γ P W Pk ∨ ghostVar γ.cls (Qp.half 1) ())

theorem backend.stop_get (γ : backend.BNames) (sc : GoChan) (γsc : ChanNames) : backend.stopInv γ sc
    γsc ∗ backend.stopQ γ ∗ backend.runTok γ ⊢ |={⊤}=> dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) false

theorem backend.bStopG_view (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (C :
    backend.Data) : backend.bStopG γ P C ∗ W ∗ Pk ⊢ backend.bStopView γ P W Pk C

theorem backend.bDoneEsc_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) :
    Persistent (backend.bDoneEsc γ P W Pk)

def backend.stopInv (γ : backend.BNames) (sc : GoChan) (γsc : ChanNames) : IProp GF :=
  inv (backend.bN.@"stop")
    iprop(ownBroadcastChan sc γsc (backend.stopQ γ) Broadcast.Pending ∗ dghostVar γ.sdn (DFrac.own 1) false ∨
        ghostVar γ.cls (Qp.half 1) () ∗ (dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) false ∨ backend.runTok γ))

theorem backend.isStopChansE_intro (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b :
    Loc) : backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗ backend.isStopChans γ P W Pk b ⊢ backend.isStopChansE γ P
    b

def backend.stopQ (γ : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  dghostVar γ.sdn DFrac.discard true

theorem backend.stop_take (γ : backend.BNames) (sc : GoChan) (γsc : ChanNames) : backend.stopInv γ
    sc γsc ∗ backend.bOpen γ 1 ⊢ |={⊤}=> ▷ ownBroadcastChan sc γsc (backend.stopQ γ)
    Broadcast.Pending ∗ backend.stopQ γ ∗ ghostVar γ.cls (Qp.half 1) ()

theorem backend.stopInv_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (sc : GoChan) (γsc : ChanNames) : Persistent
    (backend.stopInv γ sc γsc)

def backend.isStopChansAt (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc) (sc
    dc : GoChan) (γsc γdc : ChanNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"stopc" b) sc DFrac.discard ∗
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"donec" b) dc DFrac.discard ∗
        ownBroadcastChan sc γsc (backend.stopQ γ) Broadcast.Unknown ∗
          ownBroadcastChan dc γdc (backend.bDoneEsc γ P W Pk) Broadcast.Unknown ∗ backend.stopInv γ sc γsc)

theorem backend.isStopChansAt_persistent (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp
    GF) (b : Loc) (sc dc : GoChan) (γsc γdc : ChanNames) : Persistent (backend.isStopChansAt γ P W
    Pk b sc dc γsc γdc)

def backend.isStopChans (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ sc dc γsc γdc, backend.isStopChansAt γ P W Pk b sc dc γsc γdc)

def backend.runTok (γ : backend.BNames) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ.stk 1 ()
